title: Inventario Real de Hermes v0.21.6 — Memoria Persistente y Skills Reutilizables

persistent_memory.locking_mechanism: Cross-process file lock (.lock sibling file via msvcrt.locking on Windows) + atomic temp-file rename

cross_session_lifecycle.session_start: AIAgent._init_memory() instantiates MemoryStore and calls load_from_disk(), capturing a frozen _system_prompt_snapshot injected into the volatile tier of the system prompt.
cross_session_lifecycle.mid_session_writes: Calls to the memory tool immediately update self.memory_entries / self.user_entries, acquire the file lock, and atomically write MEMORY.md / USER.md to disk.
cross_session_lifecycle.next_session_recall: Any new session (new session_id) running under -p desarrollador-autonomo loads MEMORY.md from disk at startup and injects it into the system prompt under 'MEMORY (your personal notes)'.

builtin_scan_vs_required_sanitization.builtin_scan: tools/memory_tool_store.py::_scan_memory_content checks prompt injection patterns and blocks only quoted 20+ char api_key/token/secret via hardcoded_secret threat pattern without redacting to [REDACTED].
builtin_scan_vs_required_sanitization.required_sanitization_gap: Unquoted password=..., token=..., Bearer ..., sk-..., ghp_... would either pass through unredacted or fail without redacting to [REDACTED].
builtin_scan_vs_required_sanitization.solution: Configure native Hermes pre_tool_call shell hook (agent/shell_hooks.py) with hooks_auto_accept: true and fail_closed: true pointing to scripts/hermes-pre-tool-hook.py, which intercepts memory tool calls before MemoryStore.add/replace runs and rewrites sensitive patterns to [REDACTED] via {'action': 'modify', 'args': ...}, plus PowerShell helper scripts/hermes-memory-guard.ps1 for deterministic CLI/file sanitization.

reusable_skills.native_implementation: Progressive disclosure SKILL.md system (tools/skills_tool.py + tools/skill_manager_tool.py + agent/prompt_builder.py)

format.frontmatter: YAML frontmatter delimited by --- requiring 'name' (^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$, max 64 chars) and 'description' (concise 1-sentence description <= 150 chars)

discovery_and_loading.tier_1_index: build_skills_system_prompt() scans ~/.hermes/skills/ and injects a compact category/name/description index into the volatile tier of the system prompt.
discovery_and_loading.tier_2_on_demand: The agent calls skills_list() or skill_view(name, file_path) to load full Markdown instructions on demand.
discovery_and_loading.preload_options: CLI flag -s / --skills <name> or config.yaml skills.auto_load list preloads full SKILL.md content into the system prompt at session start.
discovery_and_loading.oneshot_q_behavior: In -q (oneshot) mode, agent/oneshot_footprint.py hides skill_manage (authoring) but keeps skills_list and skill_view enabled. ONESHOT_SKILLS_LOAD_GUIDANCE instructs loading skills that carry project-specific conventions/contracts, and -s <skill> or skills.auto_load preloads them deterministically.

tiers_order: 1. stable tier: SOUL.md identity -> tool & execution guidance -> skills.auto_load -> coding prefix
2. context tier: caller system_message -> project context files (AGENTS.md) -> workspace snapshot
3. volatile tier: skills index (_skills_prompt) -> MEMORY.md & USER.md snapshot -> plugin sections -> active profile -> timestamp

truth_hierarchy_enforcement.level_1_authoritative: Filesystem, Git status/diff, real test/build execution, .autopilot/RUN-CONTRACT.yaml, .autopilot/STATE.json, .autopilot/EVENTS.jsonl
truth_hierarchy_enforcement.level_2_auxiliary: Hermes MEMORY.md, USER.md, session history, reusable skills
truth_hierarchy_enforcement.enforcement_mechanism: Reinforced in profile SOUL.md, AGENTS.md context injection, skill contracts, and pre_tool_call hook validation.

capabilities: Modify tool arguments before execution via stdout JSON {'action': 'modify', 'args': {...}}
Block unauthorized tool calls before execution via stdout JSON {'action': 'block', 'message': '...'} or exit code 2
Fail closed (fail_closed: true) if the hook script errors or times out
